title: Presentation: From Fan-Out to Fast: Sub-100ms API Design in Distributed Systems
summary: Saranya Vedagiri explains how to design resilient, low-latency distributed APIs under 100ms. Drawing on practical scale at eBay, she discusses hop-by-hop latency budgets, async fanout tradeoffs, thread pool sizing, caching, and circuit breakers. Learn actionable strategies to eliminate tail-latency bottlenecks and establish performance-first engineering practices. By Saranya Vedagiri

title: Article: Engineering Reliable Telematics from Smartphone Sensors
summary: Smartphones make telematics more accessible by combining location, motion sensors, computing power, and connectivity in a single device. But the convenience comes with a trade-off: device placement varies, sampling behavior is managed by the mobile platform, and measurements have different timing and coordinate semantics. This article explores a six-stage architecture to address these challenges. By Praveen Kumar Gopalakrishnan
